name: grafana
label: Grafana
description: Lets Copilot chats read logs, metrics and dashboards of your environments with `grafana …`, read only, instead of a shell on servers.

GRAFANA_INSTANCES.label: Grafana environments
GRAFANA_INSTANCES.hint: One row per environment: its short name, and its address. Kept in your settings file only.

GRAFANA_ASK.label: Ask every time for
GRAFANA_ASK.hint: Environments that ask in the chat before each read.

GRAFANA_TOKENS.label: Viewer tokens (optional)
GRAFANA_TOKENS.hint: Not needed: log in below with your browser instead. If you can create a Grafana service account with the Viewer role, its token (name=glsa_…) is used instead of the login.

secrets.note: optional Viewer service-account tokens; else your browser login

doors.name: grafana
doors.about: reads logs, metrics and dashboards as you, read only; environments that ask (prod) ask in the chat each time

note: Reaches the Grafana addresses you set (yours, kept in your settings only). Secrets it knows the shape of are removed from what comes back, and every call is in Copilot's changes.
outside: It reads Grafana with your login for chats that can't hold it, which is what a door is for.
